Eddington
programme.desc: A standoff between a small-town sheriff and mayor sparks a powder keg as neighbor is pitted against neighbor in May 2020 in Eddington, N.M.

programme.title: Fackham Hall
programme.desc: Eric Noone begins a forbidden romance with Rose Davenport, the lady of the house at a posh English manor. When an unexpected murder occurs, Eric gets framed, leaving Rose and her family's future uncertain.

programme.title: Birdman or (The Unexpected Virtue of Ignorance)
programme.desc: A washed-up actor (Michael Keaton), whose previous claim to fame was his portrayal of a popular superhero, attempts to recapture his past glory by mounting a Broadway play.

programme.title: The First Purge
programme.desc: Violence and mayhem spread across the nation when the New Founding Fathers of America try a radical sociological experiment that allows citizens to vent their aggression for one night in an isolated community.

programme.title: A Revolution on Canvas
programme.desc: Sara Nodjoumi investigates the disappearance of more than 100

programme.title: Marc by Sofia
programme.desc: Sofia Coppola captures the genius and singular universe of iconic American fashion designer Marc Jacobs.

programme.title: Red Sparrow
programme.desc: Dominika Egorova learns to use her mind and body as a weapon after joining a secret intelligence service. As she comes to terms with her new abilities, Dominika meets a CIA agent who tries to convince her that he is the only person she can trust.

programme.title: Just Friends
programme.desc: A music executive (Ryan Reynolds) tries to woo his high-school crush (Amy Smart) while keeping his suspicious ex-girlfriend (Anna Faris) at bay.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: As two clans descend on the scene of young twins' birthday, Greg Focker's moonlighting at a pharmaceutical company threatens to derail his position of trust with Jack, his uptight father-in-law.

programme.title: Tag
programme.desc: Music teacher Tag meets Farida, and a whirlwind love story develops. Tag starts to display superhuman powers of mysterious origins. He tries to hide them, but keeps facing situations that force him to intervene, especially when his brother shows up.

programme.title: The Royal Tenenbaums
programme.desc: An errant father (Gene Hackman) tries to reconcile with his eccentric and underachieving family (Anjelica Huston, Ben Stiller) in New York.

programme.title: Love, Simon
programme.desc: Teenager Simon Spier hasn't told his family or friends that he's gay, and he doesn't know the identity of the anonymous classmate that he's fallen for online. Resolving both issues proves hilarious, terrifying and life-changing.

programme.title: Materialists
programme.desc: A young, ambitious New York City matchmaker finds herself torn between the perfect match and her imperfect ex.

programme.title: The Invite
programme.desc: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When their upstairs neighbors visit for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?

programme.title: Anyone But You
programme.desc: Despite an amazing first date, Bea and Ben's initial attraction quickly turns sour. However, when they unexpectedly find themselves at a destination wedding in Australia, they pretend to be the perfect couple to keep up appearances.

programme.title: House Party
programme.desc: Aspiring club promoters and best buds Damon and Kevin need a huge windfall to make their problems go away. They decide to host the party of the year at an exclusive mansion, which just happens to belong to none other than NBA superstar LeBron James.

programme.title: Life of the Party
programme.desc: Dumped by her husband, longtime housewife Deanna turns regret into reset by going back to college. Winding up at the same school as her daughter, Deanna plunges headlong into the campus experience -- embracing the fun, the freedom and the frat boys.

programme.title: Boys Go to Jupiter
programme.desc: Billy 5000, a teenage gig worker with a rise-and-grind mindset, aims to make $5,000. His quest is derailed by a gelatinous alien's appearance.

programme.title: David Bowie: The Last Five Years
programme.desc: A detailed look at the final five years of David Bowie's life when he not only began producing music again, but returned to the core and defining themes of his career.

programme.title: Paul Anka: His Way
programme.desc: An all-encompassing tribute, brimming with archival footage and candid moments, Anka, still going strong, offers in his own words a vivid glimpse into his remarkable life and enduring legacy.

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Reluctant to dance, the son of Mumble (Elijah Wood) the tap-dancing penguin runs away from home and meets a penguin that can fly.

programme.title: The Man Who Invented Christmas
programme.desc: Using real-life inspiration and his vivid imagination, author Charles Dickens brings Ebenezer Scrooge, Tiny Tim and other classic characters to life in A Christmas Carol, forever changing the holiday season into the celebration known today.

programme.title: Prancer: A Christmas Tale
programme.desc: Ten-year-old Gloria and her grandfather Bud befriend a mysterious reindeer when the family gathers for Christmas. Bud comes to believe that Prancer may actually be magical, but Gloria fears his theory will send him straight to a retirement home.

programme.title: Christmas With the Kranks
programme.desc: A Chicago couple scramble to put together a holiday celebration after their daughter decides to come home for Christmas.

programme.title: A Very Harold & Kumar 3D Christmas
programme.desc: Six years after their last adventure, the infamous stoners (John Cho, Kal Penn) reunite on Christmas Eve to find a replacement tree for the one Harold sent up in smoke.

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Taken hostage with his wife in Istanbul, retired CIA agent Bryan Mills (Liam Neeson) enlists his daughter's (Maggie Grace) aid in helping him escape, then uses his particular set of skills to exact revenge on the kidnappers.

programme.title: Greenland
programme.desc: A family embarks on a perilous journey as a planet-killing comet hurtles toward Earth. As the countdown to the global apocalypse approaches zero, their incredible trek culminates in a desperate and last-minute flight to a possible safe haven.

programme.title: Greenland 2: Migration
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a comet strike that decimated most of the planet, the Garrity family must leave the safety of their Greenland bunker to traverse a shattered world in search of a new home.

programme.title: The Amateur
programme.desc: Charlie Heller is a brilliant CIA decoder whose world comes crashing down when his wife dies in a London terrorist attack. When his supervisors refuse to take action, he embarks on a dangerous trek across the globe to track down those responsible.

programme.title: If I Had Legs I'd Kick You
programme.desc: With her life crashing down around her, Linda attempts to navigate her child's mysterious illness, her absent husband, a missing person, and an increasingly hostile relationship with her therapist.

programme.title: Blockers
programme.desc: Lisa, Hunter and Mitchell learn that their teenage daughters plan to lose their virginity on prom night. The worried parents soon join forces for a wild and chaotic quest to stop the girls from sealing the deal -- no matter what the cost.

programme.title: Project X
programme.desc: Three anonymous high-school seniors decide to make their mark by throwing a party that no one will ever forget.

programme.title: Music Box: Yacht Rock: A Dockumentary
programme.desc: Chronicling the emergence and popularity of the West Coast, soft rock pop culture epitomized by musical artists such as Christopher Cross, Michael McDonald, Kenny Loggins, Steely Dan and Toto.

programme.title: Stand Up & Shout: Songs From a Philly High School
programme.desc: Students at Philadelphia's Hill-Freedman World Academy work with local musicians to create an album of powerful, original songs that captures both the challenging times they're living in and the joy that music brings.

programme.title: Crazy Rich Asians
programme.desc: Rachel Chu is happy to accompany her longtime boyfriend, Nick, to his best friend's wedding in Singapore. She's also surprised to learn that Nick's family is extremely wealthy, and he's considered one of the country's most eligible bachelors.

programme.title: Barbie
programme.desc: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the colorful and seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the real world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among humans.

programme.title: Battle of the Sexes
programme.desc: The 1973 tennis match between Billie Jean King and Bobby Riggs became the most watched televised sports event of all time. While trapped in the media glare, King and Riggs fight more personal and complex battles.

programme.title: The Hole in the Ground
programme.desc: One night, Sarah's young son disappears into the woods behind their rural home. When he returns, he looks the same, but his behavior grows increasingly disturbing. Sarah begins to believe that the boy who returned may not be her son at all.

programme.title: Carrie
programme.desc: Tormented by her peers and sheltered by her religious mother (Julianne Moore), an awkward teenager (Chloë Grace Moretz) unleashes her hidden, telekinetic powers after a sick prank at her senior prom pushes her over the edge.

programme.title: Evil Dead II
programme.desc: Ash Williams, the lone survivor of an earlier onslaught of flesh-possessing spirits, holes up in a cabin with a group of strangers while the demons continue their attack.

programme.title: Evil Dead Rise
programme.desc: A reunion between two estranged sisters gets cut short by the rise of flesh-possessing demons, thrusting them into a primal battle for survival as they face the most nightmarish version of family imaginable.

programme.title: Evil Dead Burn
programme.desc: After the loss of her husband, a grieving woman seeks solace with her in-laws at their secluded family home. However, it soon becomes a reunion from hell as the Book of the Dead unleashes demonic forces that transform them into Deadites one by one.

programme.title: Dust Bunny
programme.desc: Ten-year-old Aurora asks a hit man to kill the monster she believes ate her entire family. To protect her, he'll need to battle an onslaught of assassins while accepting the fact that some monsters are real.

programme.title: Christy
programme.desc: Christy Martin never imagined life beyond her small-town roots in West Virginia. Fueled by grit, raw determination, and an unshakable desire to win, she charges into the world of boxing under the guidance of her trainer and manager-turned-husband.

programme.title: The Smashing Machine
programme.desc: The true story of mixed martial arts and UFC fighter Mark Kerr, whose obsession with greatness made him a legend -- and nearly cost him everything.

programme.title: The Color Purple
programme.desc: Torn apart from her sister and her children, Celie faces many hardships, including an abusive husband. With support from a singer and her stepdaughter, she ultimately finds extraordinary strength in the unbreakable bonds of a new kind of sisterhood.

programme.title: Terry Bradshaw: Going Deep
programme.desc: Terry Bradshaw takes the stage at the Clay Cooper Theater in Branson, Mo., for a series of live performances that offer a mix of singing, music, colorful stories, and honest and emotional reflections on his life.

programme.title: Student Athlete
programme.desc: The exploitative world of high revenue college sports is unveiled through the stories of four young men at different stages of their athletic careers, as well as a coach-turned-advocate and a whistleblowing shoe rep who exposes the money trail.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
programme.desc: A chosen hobbit (Elijah Wood) and his loyal friends join a wizard (Ian McKellen), humans, a dwarf and an elf on a quest to destroy a powerful ring and defeat an evil lord.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
programme.desc: Now divided, members of a fellowship take different paths to destroy the ring and defeat evil Sauron and his pawns.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
programme.desc: Frodo (Elijah Wood) and Sam march toward Mount Doom to destroy the ring, while Gandalf (Ian McKellen) and warriors prepare for a final confrontation with Sauron and his allies.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The War of the Rohirrim
programme.desc: A sudden attack by Wulf, a ruthless Dunlending lord, forces Helm Hammerhand and his people to make a daring last stand in the ancient stronghold of the Hornburg. Finding herself in a desperate situation, Helm's daughter must lead the resistance.

programme.title: Normal
programme.desc: The new sheriff of a small town in Minnesota uncovers a dark secret while investigating a botched bank robbery.

programme.title: Maze Runner: The Death Cure
programme.desc: Thomas leads some escaped Gladers on their final and most dangerous mission yet. To save their friends, they must break into the legendary Last City, a WCKD-controlled labyrinth that may turn out to be the deadliest maze of all.

programme.title: The Cabin in the Woods
programme.desc: Two unseen scientists manipulate the gory goings-on at a backwoods cabin inhabited by a group of unsuspecting college friends (Kristen Connolly, Chris Hemsworth, Anna Hutchison).

programme.title: Blue Beetle
programme.desc: Jaime Reyes finds himself in possession of an ancient relic of alien biotechnology called the Scarab. When the Scarab chooses Jaime to be its symbiotic host, he's bestowed with a suit of armor that's capable of extraordinary and unpredictable powers.

programme.title: The Lionheart
programme.desc: In 2011, two-time Indianapolis 500 champion Dan Wheldon died in a horrific crash at the Las Vegas Motor Speedway, shaking the world of motorsports to its core. Ten years later, Dan's two sons, Sebastian and Oliver, follow in their father's footsteps.

programme.title: Quad Gods
programme.desc: Following the lives of three New Yorkers with quadriplegia who meet in a neuro rehabilitation lab where they create the world's first ever, fully quadriplegic e-sports team.

programme.title: Tusk
programme.desc: A U.S. podcaster (Justin Long) ventures into the Canadian wilderness to interview an old man (Michael Parks) who has an extraordinary past, and the American learns the man has a dark secret involving a walrus.

programme.title: Spinal Tap II: The End Continues
programme.desc: Documentarian Marty DiBergi follows Spinal Tap as they prepare for a reunion concert. Joined by Paul McCartney and Elton John, they wrestle with their checkered past to put on a show that they hope will solidify their place in rock 'n' roll history.

programme.title: The Strangers: Chapter 2
programme.desc: After learning that their victim, Maya, is still alive, three masked maniacs return to finish the job. With nowhere to run and no one to trust, Maya finds herself in a fight for survival against psychopaths who'll kill anyone who stands in their way.

programme.title: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
programme.desc: A reluctant Hobbit, Bilbo Baggins, sets out to the Lonely Mountain with a spirited group of dwarves to reclaim their mountain home, and the gold within it from the dragon Smaug.

programme.title: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
programme.desc: The dwarves, along with Bilbo Baggins and Gandalf the Grey, continue their quest to reclaim Erebor, their homeland, from Smaug. Bilbo Baggins is in possession of a mysterious and magical ring.

programme.title: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
programme.desc: Bilbo and company are forced to engage in a war against an array of combatants and keep the Lonely Mountain from falling into the hands of a rising darkness.

programme.title: One Battle After Another
programme.desc: Bob is a washed-up revolutionary who lives in a state of paranoia, surviving off-grid with his daughter, Willa. When his nemesis resurfaces and Willa goes missing, the former radical scrambles to find her while battling the consequences of his past.

programme.title: Deadpool 2
programme.desc: Wisecracking mercenary Deadpool must protect a teenage mutant from Cable -- a genetically enhanced soldier from the future. He soon joins forces with Bedlam, Shatterstar, Domino and other mutants to battle Cable and his powerful advanced weaponry.

programme.title: The Wolverine
programme.desc: In Japan and vulnerable for the first time, Wolverine (Hugh Jackman) confronts lethal samurai steel and grapples with the ghosts of his own haunted past.

programme.title: Rise of the Guardians
programme.desc: Winter sprite Jack Frost (Chris Pine) must save the day when an evil boogeyman (Jude Law) schemes to stop the world's children from believing in Santa Claus (Alec Baldwin), the Easter Bunny and other immortal Guardians.

programme.title: Alive Day Memories: Home From Iraq
programme.desc: Ten soldiers who suffered traumatic injuries during the Iraq war discuss their experiences with actor James Gandolfini.

programme.title: Last Letters Home: Voices of American Troops From the Battlefields of Iraq
programme.desc: Families of fallen U.S. soldiers read their last correspondence from Iraq.

programme.title: War Dog: A Soldier's Best Friend
programme.desc: Highlighting the stories of three courageous dogs and the soldiers who served by their side in the most elite forces in the military.

programme.title: Coraline
programme.desc: A girl finds a secret door in her new home and walks into an alternate reality that closely mirrors her own but, in many ways, is better.

programme.title: The Boxtrolls
programme.desc: A boy (Isaac Hempstead-Wright) and his new friend (Elle Fanning) hatch a plan to save a community of mischievous cavern-dwellers from the villainous townsman (Ben Kingsley) who plans to exterminate them.

programme.title: The Wolverine
programme.desc: In Japan and vulnerable for the first time, Wolverine (Hugh Jackman) confronts lethal samurai steel and grapples with the ghosts of his own haunted past.

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Fueled by his restored faith in humanity and inspired by Superman's selfless act, Batman and his new ally Wonder Woman recruit Aquaman, Cyborg and the Flash to help them save the planet from a newly awakened enemy.

programme.title: The Lighthouse
programme.desc: Two lighthouse keepers try to maintain their sanity while living on a remote and mysterious New England island in the 1890s.

programme.title: The Housemaid
programme.desc: Hoping for a fresh start, a young woman becomes a live-in maid for a wealthy couple who harbor sinister secrets.

programme.title: Mother Mary
programme.desc: Long-buried wounds rise to the surface when pop star Mother Mary reunites with her estranged best friend and former costume designer Sam Anselm on the eve of her comeback performance.

programme.title: Thanksgiving
programme.desc: A mysterious masked maniac terrorizes residents of Plymouth, Mass., one year after a Black Friday riot ended in tragedy. Picking off victims one by one, the seemingly random revenge killings soon become part of a larger, sinister plan.

programme.title: Insidious: The Last Key
programme.desc: Parapsychologist Elise Rainier and her team travel to Five Keys, N.M., to investigate a claim of a haunting in her childhood home. She must soon confront and destroy her greatest fear, the demon that she accidentally set free years earlier.

programme.title: Just Friends
programme.desc: A music executive (Ryan Reynolds) tries to woo his high-school crush (Amy Smart) while keeping his suspicious ex-girlfriend (Anna Faris) at bay.

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Taken hostage with his wife in Istanbul, retired CIA agent Bryan Mills (Liam Neeson) enlists his daughter's (Maggie Grace) aid in helping him escape, then uses his particular set of skills to exact revenge on the kidnappers.

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: The Green Lanterns have little regard for humans, who have been unable to harness the powers of the ring each member wears. But Jordan, a test pilot, may be the corps' only hope when an enemy called Parallax threatens the universal balance of power.

programme.title: Green Lantern: First Flight
programme.desc: The Green Lantern must race against time to stop Sinestro from unleashing a sinister plot.

programme.title: Green Lantern: Beware My Power
programme.desc: When a Power Ring is bestowed upon former Marine John Stewart, it leads him on a life-changing mission. With Justice League member Green Arrow and Thanagarian Hawkgirl by his side, Stewart is thrown into a complicated galactic war.

programme.title: Green Lantern: Emerald Knights
programme.desc: New recruit Arisia (Elisabeth Moss) joins forces with Hal Jordan (Nathan Fillion) to save the universe from the forces of Krona.

programme.title: Wartorn 1861-2010
programme.desc: Post-traumatic stress disorder affects U.S. soldiers since the Civil War.

programme.title: We Stand Alone Together: The Men of Easy Company
programme.desc: In 1943, U.S. troops ship out to engage in combat behind enemy lines during World War II.

programme.title: Aquaman
programme.desc: Aquaman must retrieve the legendary Trident of Atlan to save the underwater city of Atlantis -- and the surface world -- from his power-hungry brother.

programme.title: Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom
programme.desc: Black Manta wields the power of the mythic Black Trident to unleash an ancient and malevolent force. Hoping to end his reign of terror, Aquaman forges an unlikely alliance with his brother to protect their kingdom and save the world from destruction.

programme.title: Madame Web
programme.desc: Cassandra Webb is a New York City paramedic who starts to show signs of clairvoyance. Forced to confront revelations about her past, she must protect three young women from a mysterious adversary who wants them dead.

programme.title: Supergirl
programme.desc: Kara (Helen Slater) of Argo City poses as Clark Kent's cousin, Linda Lee, to recover the Omegahedron from a witch (Faye Dunaway).
